steps.instruction: Add a new variant { kind: "clear" } to the Command union. Change nothing else. Todo stays the same; its `done` field is the 'completed' flag.
steps.interfaceChange: export type Command = { kind: "add"; title: string; due?: string; } | { kind: "complete"; id: number; } | { kind: "list"; } | { kind: "clear"; };

steps.instruction:
Add a 'clear' command that removes every todo whose `done` field is true. types will add a new Command variant { kind: "clear" }, so handle it everywhere you switch on Command.
1) Export a pure function `clear(todos: Todo[]): Todo[]`. It returns a new array with only the todos where done === false, kept in their original order and with their ids unchanged. Do not mutate the input.
2) parseArgs(["clear"]) returns { kind: "clear" }.
3) run(path, { kind: "clear" }) loads the todos from path, removes the done ones, saves the rest back to path, and returns `Cleared N todo` when N === 1 and `Cleared N todos` otherwise, where N is the number removed (e.g. "Cleared 0 todos", "Cleared 1 todo", "Cleared 2 todos").
Keep all existing behaviour exactly as it is.
steps.interfaceChange: export declare function clear(todos: Todo[]): Todo[];

input.reason: There is no field called "completed" on Todo. The field that marks a todo as completed is `done`, and the `complete` command sets it, so I read the request as "remove todos where done is true". This needs a new Command variant in types. In commands it needs a clear() helper, handling in parseArgs and in run, which saves the result and reports the count.
